Veterans Benefits: North Dakota fully exempts military retirement pay from state income tax (effective tax year 2019). Disabled veterans with a 50% or greater service-connected rating qualify for the Disabled Veterans Property Tax Credit on their homestead.

Description: Minot anchors north-central North Dakota around Minot Air Force Base (5th Bomb Wing, B-52H; 91st Missile Wing, Minuteman III ICBM). It offers an in-city VA outpatient clinic, North Dakota's full exemption of military retirement pay, and a stable base-and-energy economy. Tradeoffs are the climate and remoteness: long, severe winters (about 52 inches of snow, January lows near zero) and roughly 250 miles to the nearest VA hospital and Costco.
